title: Anonyme Skulpturen (o. O.)
summary: A Becher-style typological grid of water towers generated per visit and demolished on reload, never stored and never re-photographable.
mechanism: Client-side canvas procedurally draws twelve frontally-framed water-tower silhouettes in a fixed grid, held only in RAM (no storage, no seed, no network), so reload destroys the plate irreversibly.
references: Bernd & Hilla Becher, Typologies / Anonyme Skulpturen (Water Towers)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
